metadata.mulk:notes: The public basemap default: official CARTO Dark Matter raster tiles over a near-black ground tuned to the MULK midnight palette. Raster deliberately - CARTO bakes properly shaped Arabic/Kurdish labels server-side, and a style with NO glyphs entry keeps every MULK-drawn label (project names, prices, cluster counts) on maplibre-gl's local TinySDF path, where the bundled RTL plugin plus device Arabic fonts render Sorani correctly. Served same-origin so no-config deployments and CI depend on no third-party demo infrastructure for the style document itself.
